publicFiles.llms.txt:
# Feluqa Documentation

> Documentation for Feluqa, a proprietary platform and unified namespace for building applications across web, workstation, mobile, games, APIs, and real-time systems. The target architecture is still under development.

## Guides

- [Feluqa](/get-started/) — product direction, setup, and application development.
- [Feluqa’s Internals](/feluqa-internals/) — runtime, workspace, and compile-time architecture.
- [Agents](/agents/) — contribution guidance for AI coding agents.
- [Learn](/learn/) — practical application tutorials.

## Documentation status

Treat pages marked Exploring as provisional and pages marked Target as planned product direction. Do not describe planned capabilities as implemented.

faq.question: What is Feluqa?
faq.answer: Feluqa is a proprietary platform and unified namespace for building applications across web, workstation, mobile, games, APIs, and real-time systems. The target architecture is still under development.

faq.question: Where should I start?
faq.answer: Start with Get started to understand the current product direction, set up a development environment, and follow the application guides.

faq.question: Is the complete platform available today?
faq.answer: No. The repository provides selected framework foundations, while several target capabilities such as dynamic module installation and complete runtime shells remain in active development.

faq.question: Qu’est-ce que Feluqa ?
faq.answer: Feluqa est une plateforme propriétaire et un espace de noms unifié pour créer des applications web, poste de travail, mobiles, de jeux, des API et des systèmes temps réel. L’architecture cible est encore en développement.

faq.question: Par où commencer ?
faq.answer: Commencez par Bien démarrer pour comprendre l’orientation actuelle du produit, préparer votre environnement et suivre les guides de développement.

faq.question: La plateforme complète est-elle disponible aujourd’hui ?
faq.answer: Non. Le dépôt fournit certaines fondations du framework, tandis que plusieurs capacités cibles, dont l’installation dynamique de modules et les shells runtime complets, sont encore en développement.
